thread:
Maya R: hey team — I'm Maya, started on eng-platform today. Trying to set up kube access on my laptop. Two problems: 1) after merging a vendor kubeconfig I get 'no context' when running kubectl, 2) I need access to namespaces 'redwood-dev' and 'ml-experiments'. Who should I ping for RBAC or a quick kubeconfig fix?

Ana (devex): welcome Maya :tada: Add yourself to the platform-developers group and you should get namespace access. For kubeconfig we have rwd-kube that handles safe merges. Try `brew install redwood/tap/rwd-kube` or ask infra to install if on a managed image.

Maya R: I don't have rwd-kube and brew isn't allowed on my corp image. When I run `kubectl config get-contexts` I only see "minikube" and "docker-desktop" — vendor kubeconfig seemed to merge but no new contexts.

chris-enginfra: hey Maya — you can also request access via infractl if you prefer: `infractl request-kube --user maya.r@redwood.com --ns redwood-dev,ml-experiments`. That wires RBAC and will create contexts for you. If you'd rather a manual hint: check KUBECONFIG env and ~/.kube/config files, merging can fail silently.

eng-infra-bot: Request received: ticket KUBE-5342 created for maya.r, target namespaces: redwood-dev, ml-experiments. Eng infra will review. ETA ~30m.

lars-sre: quick manual diagnostic if you want to try now — run:
```
# confirm which files are being used
echo $KUBECONFIG || echo ~/.kube/config
# list raw contexts from vendor file (replace path)
kubectl --kubeconfig=/path/to/vendor/config config get-contexts -o name
# flatten a safe merged config locally (non-destructive):
KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config:/path/to/vendor/config kubectl config view --flatten > /tmp/kube.merged && mv /tmp/kube.merged ~/.kube/config
# then list contexts
kubectl config get-contexts
```
Don't run anything that points you at prod. If a context called `redwood-dev` appears, `kubectl config use-context redwood-dev` should work once RBAC is granted.

Maya R: thanks — I checked KUBECONFIG and it was unset, vendor file didn't get copied. I ran the flatten step with the vendor path (had to scp it from my laptop) and now I see a context `redwood-dev/user-maya`. Trying infractl request in case RBAC still blocks me.

chris-enginfra: cool. Once the infra ticket is approved you may still need a rolebinding; infra team will attach it to platform-developers. Should be quick.

eng-infra-bot: KUBE-5342 updated: approved by eng-infra, rolebinding applied to user maya.r@redwood.com in redwood-dev.

Maya R: confirmed — `kubectl get pods -n redwood-dev` works and I can switch contexts. Thank you everyone! :bow:
